extra.message: Use of execSync with string concatenation creates potential command injection vulnerability. The vulnerable code constructs shell commands by concatenating user-provided values directly into strings, which can be exploited to execute arbitrary commands. Replace execSync with execFileSync and pass arguments as an array to prevent shell injection. Additionally, the return type was changed from Buffer to String|Buffer to handle potential string outputs from execFileSync.
